capabilities: Edit flowchart, state, sequence, mindmap and class diagrams visually
Sprout connected elements and drag handles to connect them
Rename elements and connection labels inline
Sync edits to plain Mermaid source with a live syntax drawer
Export diagrams as PNG or SVG at multiple resolutions
extras: Also ships as a VS Code extension for VS Code, Cursor, Devin and VSCodium; can create and edit standalone .mmd and .mermaid files; saves are checked by re-rendering and reverted with a notice if the edit fails; README points to a separate Known issues page for syntax limits and testing scope.
motivation: The author wanted structural rather than spatial editing, because visual editors that impose coordinates cause broken round-trips, syntax corruption and layout drift.
problem: Mermaid diagrams in Obsidian can only be changed by editing their code, so restructuring a diagram by hand is slow and easy to break.

relations.evidence: Controls are overlaid directly on Obsidian's exact Mermaid SVG rendering

summary: Visual overlay editor for Mermaid diagrams that sprouts, connects and renames elements while saving plain Mermaid text in the note.
